# OpenClaw Research Area

This directory is reserved for OpenClaw investigation.

Rules:

1. Do not place OpenClaw source inside Deepseek-pet.
2. Do not modify OpenClaw core during Phase 0.
3. Do not treat installed CLI binaries as FJK project source.
4. Do not couple pet runtime directly to OpenClaw internals.
5. Gateway/API integration must be preferred over core modification.
6. Any future vendoring/fork/submodule decision requires a separate architecture decision.
